# City of Malden
## Massachusetts
### Board of Appeal
215 Pleasant Street
Malden, Massachusetts 02148

Telephone 781-397-7000 x 2104

## Board of Appeal - Public Meeting
## August 19 , 2026
## Minutes

The Malden Board of Appeal held a Public Hearing Wednesday August 19, 2026, at 6:30 pm at Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St., Room #106 Herbert L Jackson Council Chambers, Malden, MA on the following named petitions:

Roll Call: Cramer, D’Esposito, Froio and King

**Petition 26-007** by **Mystic Valley Regional Charter School** seeking a variance under Code of the City of Malden as amended – **Title 4 Section 4.16.090 (A) Table of Intensity Regulations: Specifically: Awning sign in the Residence A Zoning District as per plans SGER-077161-2026** at the property known as and numbered **31 Granite St., Malden, MA** and also known by City Assessor's

Shorty before tonight’s meeting we received notification from Alfred Carrier that they did not advertise for the hearing, therefore, will need to postpone this hearing till the September 16, 2026 meeting.

Motion by D’Esposito to adjourn, 2nd by Froio – All in favor, Adjourned at 6:31pm.
headline: Postponed hearing on Mystic Valley Regional Charter School variance petition to September 16, 2026.
summary: The board planned to hear Petition 26-007 from Mystic Valley Regional Charter School about an awning sign variance at 31 Granite St. Because notice was not properly advertised, the hearing was postponed to the September 16, 2026 meeting.
decisions: Postponed the hearing on Petition 26-007 by Mystic Valley Regional Charter School to the September 16, 2026 meeting because the hearing was not advertised.
